config.observations_mission: Maintain a readable list of currently supported personal and project information. Each observation should state one subject and one facet clearly, preserving attribution, uncertainty and scope. Include each independently useful fact from the evidence, including relationships, preferences, possessions and explicit plans. Use the latest applicable assertion date, not ingestion order. For a correction, state only the corrected information; do not narrate earlier erroneous or superseded values or invent a real-world change. Keep genuinely historical events and future plans explicitly dated as history or plans, not present state. Preserve unaffected facts when another property changes. Do not infer ownership from questions. Do not combine unrelated facets into a profile paragraph.
config.retain_mission: Remember useful user-stated personal facts, preferences, constraints, plans and project decisions. Preserve speaker identity, ownership, negation, uncertainty, dates and project scope. Questions, quotations, fictional characters and hypothetical examples are not assertions about the user. Keep explicit personal statements inside questions. Preserve each independently useful preference, including language register. Do not turn interest into ownership.

Keep explicit personal statements inside questions. Preserve each independently useful preference, including language register. Do not turn interest into ownership.

overrides.retain_mission: Remember useful user-stated personal facts, preferences, constraints, plans and project decisions. Preserve speaker identity, ownership, negation, uncertainty, dates and project scope. Questions, quotations, fictional characters and hypothetical examples are not assertions about the user. Keep explicit personal statements inside questions. Preserve each independently useful preference, including language register. Do not turn interest into ownership.
overrides.observations_mission: Maintain a readable list of currently supported personal and project information. Each observation should state one subject and one facet clearly, preserving attribution, uncertainty and scope. Include each independently useful fact from the evidence, including relationships, preferences, possessions and explicit plans. Use the latest applicable assertion date, not ingestion order. For a correction, state only the corrected information; do not narrate earlier erroneous or superseded values or invent a real-world change. Keep genuinely historical events and future plans explicitly dated as history or plans, not present state. Preserve unaffected facts when another property changes. Do not infer ownership from questions. Do not combine unrelated facets into a profile paragraph.
